rate_limits.correction: Published limits: most endpoints allow 600 requests per 60 seconds in live mode and 100 per 60 seconds in test mode, per integration and endpoint. Live-mode extended limits range from 900 to 3,000 requests per 60 seconds for specified endpoints.

notes: The entry fails because Paystack now publishes explicit rate limits, added in June 2026.
